data.long_meaning: Delnavaz is a Persian name which means 'Lord of the Fortress'. This name is derived from the Persian words 'del' meaning 'lord' and 'navaz' meaning 'fortress'. In Islamic culture, the name Delnavaz is associated with strength, protection, and leadership. The name Delnavaz carries the meaning “Lord of the Fortress” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Delnavaz usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the fortress and live with faith, good character and purpose.
